desk_reject_comments.value:
This paper is desk rejected for significant textual overlap with [1]. The introduction has significant overlap in text, and method section has significant overlap in text, both of which are without proper citation. This level of overlap is considered plagiarism. The decision was confirmed by multiple members of the program committee. 

[1] "Forgetting before Learning: Utilizing Parametric Arithmetic for Knowledge Updating in Large Language Models" by Shiwen Ni, Dingwei Chen, Chengming Li, Xiping Hu, Ruifeng Xu, Min Yang. https://arxiv.org/pdf/2311.08011
